meta.title: Fondas — Hotel operations, on autopilot
meta.description: Fondas runs the front-office admin for independent hotels: guest email drafted for your review, a morning brief before the desk opens, check-in time chasing, and plain-language answers about your hotel.

hero.badge: For independent hotel GMs · Private beta
hero.subhead: Fondas runs your hotel's front-office admin — guest emails arrive with replies drafted in your voice, the morning brief lands before the first coffee, and arrival times chase themselves. Whichever PMS you use.

emailPreview.subject: Late arrival on Friday + parking
emailPreview.message: Hello! Our flight lands at 21:40 on Friday — is check-in still possible that late? And is there parking near the hotel? Thanks, Laura
emailPreview.contextLine: Reservation matched · Fri 26 – Sun 28 · Superior Double
emailPreview.draftBody: Good evening Laura — 21:40 is no problem at all: reception is staffed until midnight and your keys will be ready. For the car, we work with the garage on Carrer del Pi, two minutes away (€24 per night). Shall I reserve a space for Friday?

briefing.name: Morning brief
briefing.description: A daily summary of arrivals, departures, VIPs, and anything that needs your attention — ready before your first coffee.

email-assistant.name: Email assistant
email-assistant.description: Every guest email arrives with a reply drafted in your hotel's voice — you review, adjust, and send.

checkin-chasing.name: Check-in time chasing
checkin-chasing.description: Automatically nudge guests for their expected arrival time and keep housekeeping one step ahead.

hotel-chat.name: Hotel query chat
hotel-chat.description: Ask anything about your hotel in plain language — occupancy, revenue, who's arriving late — and get an instant answer.

briefingPreview.greeting: Good morning. Here's your hotel today.
briefingPreview.row1rest: 3 haven't shared arrival times — chased automatically.
briefingPreview.row2rest: Drafts are ready for your review.

stats.headline: Your first 90 minutes, back.
stats.lead: Fondas gives you back the two heaviest parts of the day — guest email and the morning catch-up. Drafts and briefs are generated with AI that already knows your hotel; sending is always your call.
stats.inboxLabel: to review a reply and send it
stats.priceLabel: per property, per month — everything included
stats.setupLabel: connect your PMS and inbox — done

bundle.headline: One layer, not six subscriptions.
bundle.lead: The jobs that eat a GM's day, handled in one place — because Fondas learns your hotel once and puts it to work everywhere.
bundle.guestRepliesDesc: Every email answered in your hotel's voice.
bundle.morningBriefDesc: What matters today, before you walk in.
bundle.etaChasingDesc: Arrival times confirmed without asking twice.
bundle.askAnythingDesc: Occupancy, arrivals, tonight's picture — in plain language.
bundle.dailySignalDesc: A quiet flag when a date needs attention.

cta.headline: Ready to get your mornings back?
cta.subhead: Free for the first 20 hotels. No credit card. Works the same day.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Connect {hotel}'s property management system so Fondas can sync reservations and guests.
settings.gmailConnected: Connected to {email}. We found {count} emails from the last 7 days — drafts will be prepared for your review.
settings.hotelDetailsDesc: Your hotel's name and room count. Room count drives occupancy across briefings and the dashboard.
settings.mewsDesc: Paste the Client and Access tokens from your MEWS integration. We verify them with MEWS, then store them encrypted at rest.
settings.apaleoDesc: Connect your Apaleo account with OAuth. You'll be sent to Apaleo to grant Fondas read access; we store only an encrypted refresh token.
settings.apaleoConnected: Fondas is connected to your Apaleo account.
settings.gmailDesc: Connect the hotel inbox so Fondas can classify guest emails and draft replies for your review. We request read and send access and store only an encrypted refresh token.
settings.briefingDesc: Your name — used to address you in the brief and sign guest email replies.
settings.profileDesc: Details about your hotel and its voice — the AI uses this to write briefings, emails, and chat answers that sound like you.
settings.positioningVibePlaceholder: How would you describe the hotel's style and atmosphere?
settings.localRecommendationsPlaceholder: Restaurants, sights, and signature local tips to mention to guests
settings.parkingTransportPlaceholder: Parking options, nearest station, airport transfer info…
settings.wifiInfoPlaceholder: Wifi network and password info to share with guests
settings.roomTypesDesc: The room types your hotel offers, so the AI can refer to them by name.
settings.upsellsDesc: Paid extras you offer, with prices — so the AI can answer questions like "how much is late checkout?" correctly.
settings.reviewsDesc: Store your TripAdvisor link and paste a few reviews to generate a short summary — we never scrape live.
settings.reviewHighlightsPlaceholder: Paste a few guest reviews here
settings.reviewSummaryEmpty: No summary yet — paste some reviews and summarize.
